parameters.name: ImageFormat
parameters.description:
The format in which to export the image. Valid values:
- raw
- vhd
- qcow2
- vmdk
- vdi

Default value: raw.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The ID of the custom image.

parameters.name: OSSBucket
parameters.description: The OSS bucket in which to store the exported image.

parameters.name: OSSPrefix
parameters.description: The prefix for the OSS object. The prefix can contain digits and letters and must be 1 to 30 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the custom image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: RoleName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM role used to export the image.
